title: Bash instead of a built-in

state.user_goal: Find every TODO marker under src/ before editing one file.
state.already_have: Copilot CLI has purpose-built grep/glob/view tools with bounded output for exactly this search/read/list work.
state.proposed_tool: bash: grep -R "TODO" src && find src -type f && cat src/components/Button.tsx

falsifier: If the requested operation requires shell semantics the built-ins cannot express, or built-ins return incomplete data while bash succeeds, the gate is over-blocking.
fixture_honesty: These answers are an offline fixture, not live Jev evidence.
